visual.name: ExpandableHierarchyBarChart
visual.description: Interactive Power BI combo chart with expandable hierarchies, line overlays, comparisons, targets and variance, waterfall modes, animation, semantic secondary-axis formatting, and full Desktop evaluation. Published Power BI Service use requires a valid Microsoft Marketplace license; a 30-day trial is available, and unlicensed views display a watermark.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Category sequence for columns and waterfall steps; add more fields to define a drillable hierarchy.

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: Primary numeric value for columns/bars. Optional when a Line series is supplied, enabling a true line-only chart.

dataRoles.name: comparison
dataRoles.description: Optional auxiliary comparison or baseline measure. It is aggregated for future baseline analysis; ordered node-to-node comparisons remain independent.

dataRoles.name: series
dataRoles.description: Extra measures for clustered/stacked columns and component breakdowns in Stacked Waterfall.

dataRoles.name: line
dataRoles.description: Optional line measure over the visible hierarchy categories. Can be used on its own without Value; line points support saved source-to-destination comparisons.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional target shown as a marker on the bar.

dataRoles.name: tooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional extra measures shown in the tooltip.

enumeration.displayName: Value is total; additional series are components
